caption: The drawing features a single object, a brown duck decoy hanging horizontally by a black string attached to its back. The duck is depicted in a side view, with its body streamlined and wings neatly tucked close to its body. The color of the decoy is a uniform reddish-brown with slight shading to indicate form and depth. Both the head and tail are elongated, and a small black dot is used to depict the eye. The string extends vertically upward from the back, tied in a loop at the top, against a plain, light beige background. The composition is centered, with the duck decoy occupying the middle of the image and no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Flying Duck
